Runs as RBAC_ML_DEPLOYER_DEV
1. snow dcm deploy, forecast table and stage in WORKSPACE
2. snow feature apply, feature views in FEATURES

4. batch forecast to WORKSPACE, monitor on it
5. task graph repeats 3 and 4 monthly

1. snow dcm deploy, forecast table and stage in WORKSPACE

4. batch forecast to WORKSPACE, monitor on it
5. task graph repeats 3 and 4 monthly
